annotations.title: How much do you really earn?

description: Net income calculator for ride-hail drivers (Uber, inDrive, DiDi, Cabify, Yango) in Colombia, Peru and Bolivia: from earnings, hours and costs (fuel, commission, car rent) it gives net income per day, week and month, net per hour, and how it compares with the city's typical target. Use it when a driver asks how much they make, whether driving pays, or how to compare apps or shifts.

city.description: City, which sets currency, starting hourly target and average speed. One of: Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Lima, Arequipa, Trujillo, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, La Paz, Cochabamba.

commission_pct.description: Commission in % still to subtract, if earnings are before commission. Default 0.

country.description: Country when the city is unknown: Colombia (CO, COP), Peru (PE, PEN) or Bolivia (BO, BOB).

currency.description: Currency, when neither city nor country is known.

days_per_week.description: Days worked per week, to project week and month. Default 6.

earnings.description: Earnings in the period from the apps, in local currency.

fuel_cost.description: Total fuel spent in the period.

fuel_cost_per_km.description: Fuel cost per km (used with km).

fuel_price.description: Fuel price per gallon or liter (used with km and km_per_fuel_unit).

hours.description: Hours worked in that period (online time).

km.description: Km driven in the period, for fuel and cost per km.

km_per_fuel_unit.description: Km the car drives per gallon or liter of the fuel_price unit.

lang.description: Language of the summary: es (default) or en.

other_costs.description: Other costs in the period: car rent, maintenance, phone plan, parking.

period.description: Period of earnings and hours: day (default), week or month.

name: estimate_driver_income

app.description: The Drivaron app and its Play download link.

color.description: green, yellow or red for offers.

result.description: All numbers, raw and formatted in local currency.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer in the requested language, ready to show the driver.

title: How much do you really earn?
